text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on assessing the future conservation potential of Protected Areas for a specific primate species (woolly monkey) under climate and land-use change scenarios. While it uses land-use change (deforestation) projections as an input, its primary objective is species distribution modeling and conservation area assessment, not LULC prediction itself. The core inclusion criteria are not met: 1) The primary focus is not LULC prediction/simulation; 2) It does not implement or produce its own national-scale LULC predictions—it uses an existing deforestation projection as a model input. The paper's central research question concerns biodiversity conservation, not LULC change forecasting.)
